summary: Iteration 4 verified the code-review refactor of Modernstäd.se (backend _parse_ai / _assert_safe_email split / ai_chat helpers, frontend AiPriceAgent -> useAiAgent+ChatMessages+ChatInput+AiPriceCard split, BookingWizard slimmed with ConfirmStep+toPayload, BookingSummary split, Hero+useSeo stable keys). Also re-verified the previous booking bug (long free-text on floor/doorCode/contactPreference/street/phone/personalNumber) both via API and full UI wizard. 42/42 pytest tests pass. Frontend wizard, AI agent (chat + fixed-price card + Acceptera & boka), home/reviews/FAQ regression and mobile 390px all pass on the public preview URL.

integration_issues.issue: During Playwright runs the confirmation screen intermittently showed 'Vi kunde inte skicka bekräftelsen via e-post just nu' / 'bekräftelse via e-post kunde inte skickas' i.e. emailSent=false, even though the parallel pytest run got emailSent=true on the same endpoints. Likely Resend rate-limiting for delivered@resend.dev after many rapid test bookings; behaviour is documented (booking still registered) and not a functional break. Not caused by the refactor.

Providing name/personnummer/telefon/e-post/adress in a follow-up message triggered readyToBook -> ai-confirm-booking-btn appeared; clicking it produced ai-booking-confirmed with ai-booking-reference MS-BF3AFA.

action_items: Optional: investigate the intermittent emailSent=false observed in UI end-to-end runs (Playwright wizard + AI). Backend pytest against the same endpoints got emailSent=true, so this is most likely Resend rate-limiting for delivered@resend.dev during rapid test runs, not a refactor regression. Consider adding a lightweight resend-rate-limit backoff or explicit surface in the UI vs. current generic message.
critical_code_review_comments: useAiAgent.confirm sends personalNumber/message with '' fallbacks but does not validate presence of firstName/lastName/email/phone/street/postalCode/city/preferredDate before enabling the confirm button – it relies purely on the backend readyToBook flag set by the LLM. If the model prematurely reports readyToBook=true with missing fields the UI will 422 and only surface a toast. A client-side sanity check on details before showing ai-confirm-booking-btn would harden this against LLM drift.

AiPriceAgent chat transcript scrolls but the chat container doesn't visibly indicate that new messages arrived when the panel is scrolled up mid-conversation – consider a 'nya meddelanden'-badge or auto-scroll only when already at the bottom.

BookingWizard.toPayload always sends termsAccepted:true (the checkbox has already been validated via zod, but the field is hard-coded on submit). If the schema ever loosens, the backend could receive termsAccepted:true even if the user unchecked afterwards. Cheap fix: pass data.termsAccepted through.
AiPriceCard shows 'Rabatt (0 %)' as a full row even when the negotiated discount is 0 SEK – minor visual noise; consider hiding the row when discountPct===0.

Backend /api/health is now shape-verified but returns booleans for emailConfigured/aiConfigured without listing the underlying provider – fine for the current usage, but adding `emailProvider`/`aiProvider` strings would help ops.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://booking-staging-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests -v (42 tests). test_refactor_and_bugfix.py owns the long-free-text bug re-verification and the /api/health shape check. Wizard entry: /privat -> click data-testid=service-card-hemstadning to reveal the wizard (framer-motion whileInView makes it invisible before the card is clicked). rca of the issue: Bug 'Något gick fel när bokningen skulle skickas' from the previous iteration is fixed. Root cause was the Pydantic max_length constraints on BookingCreate.floor/doorCode/contactPreference/street/phone/personalNumber being too tight for real-world Swedish free-text inputs (e.g. 'ta trappan till höger och ring på dörren'), causing Pydantic to raise 422 which the frontend surfaced as the generic 'Något gick fel'-toast. Mitigation applied by main agent: max_length was relaxed on these fields. Verified by (a) a dedicated pytest sending the exact long strings and asserting 200 + MS- reference + persisted values on GET, and (b) an end-to-end Playwright run through all 8 wizard steps.
